articles.headline: Thousands join Indian opposition protest demanding poll chief's resignation
articles.brief: Thousands of opposition supporters joined the 'Chalo Dilli' protest in New Delhi, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral malpractice. Top opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge, launched scathing attacks against Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah, accusing them of undermining democratic institutions.

articles.headline: Five killed in fresh ethnic violence in Manipur
articles.brief: Fresh ethnic clashes in India's northeastern state of Manipur have resulted in the deaths of at least five people. Security forces have been deployed in high numbers to control the escalating tensions and restore order in the volatile region.

articles.headline: India's October coal-fired power output jumps amid hydro slump
articles.brief: India's coal-fired power generation saw its largest jump in three years during October. The surge was driven by a significant slump in hydro generation, forcing power authorities to rely heavily on coal reserves to meet domestic energy demands.

articles.headline: OPEC+ set to keep oil output targets steady
articles.brief: Sources indicate that OPEC+ is unlikely to alter its current oil production targets during the upcoming ministerial meeting, opting to maintain steady output levels as global market conditions remain balanced.

articles.headline: Xiaomi's October EV deliveries top 50,000 units
articles.brief: Chinese tech giant Xiaomi announced that its electric vehicle deliveries exceeded 50,000 units in October, marking a record monthly high for the company's automotive division as production capacity scales up rapidly.

articles.headline: Bangladesh forms wage board following violent garment protests
articles.brief: The Bangladesh government has established a new wage board to address workers' demands following days of violent protests in the vital garment manufacturing sector. Authorities hope the move will restore stability and protect export supply chains.

articles.headline: Binance resumes withdrawals after covering $6.3B in stolen funds
articles.brief: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has fully resumed user withdrawals for bitcoin and ether after successfully recovering and covering the bulk of $6.3 billion lost in a recent sophisticated security breach.

articles.headline: Ghana partners with Russia to build 2,000 MW nuclear plant
articles.brief: The government of Ghana has announced a major energy agreement with Russia to construct a 2,000-megawatt nuclear power plant, aiming to deepen bilateral ties and secure long-term baseload electricity for industrial growth.

articles.headline: India's gross GST collections jump 22.9% in October
articles.brief: India's gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections registered a strong 22.9% year-on-year increase in October, reaching Rs 2.31 lakh crore, driven by robust festive season consumer demand and improved tax compliance.

articles.headline: Cyclone Murasu triggers heavy rainfall alerts across South India
articles.brief: Cyclone Murasu has formed over the Bay of Bengal, prompting meteorological departments to issue orange alerts for several districts in Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Odisha ahead of severe downpours.

articles.headline: Gautam Gambhir issues bold message after T20 series win
articles.brief: Following India's T20 series triumph against New Zealand, head coach Gautam Gambhir delivered a bold motivational message to his players, emphasizing fearlessness and continuous improvement in all departments.

articles.headline: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS may be 7 billion years old
articles.brief: Recent astronomical analysis of the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS reveals unusual chemical markers suggesting it formed roughly 7 billion years ago, long before the birth of our own solar system.
